name: Prusa MK4 3D Printer
description: Workhorse FDM printer. Good for PLA and PETG parts up to 250mm.
notes: The middle unit has a slightly worn PEI sheet — use the left or right one for fine detail.

name: Bambu Lab X1 Carbon 3D Printer
description: Fast enclosed FDM printer with multi-material unit. Handles engineering filaments.

name: Formlabs Form 3 Resin Printer
description: SLA resin printer for high-detail miniatures, molds, and smooth-surface parts.
safetyNotes: Uncured resin is a skin and eye irritant. Wear nitrile gloves and safety glasses at all times. Do not pour resin or IPA down the drain.

name: Form Wash and Cure Station
description: Post-processing pair for resin prints: IPA wash, then UV cure.
safetyNotes: Contains isopropyl alcohol. Keep away from open flame. Gloves required when handling uncured parts.

name: Revopoint POP 3 3D Scanner
description: Handheld structured-light scanner for capturing physical objects as meshes.

name: Glowforge Pro Laser Cutter
description: CO2 laser cutter and engraver. Cuts plywood, acrylic, cardboard, leather; engraves anodized aluminum.
safetyNotes: Never cut PVC, vinyl, or unknown plastics — they release chlorine gas and destroy the optics. Never leave the machine unattended while the laser is firing. Confirm exhaust is running before starting a job.

name: Shapeoko 4 CNC Router
description: Desktop CNC router for wood, soft metals, and plastics.
safetyNotes: Eye and ear protection required. Confirm workholding before every job — a part thrown from the spindle is the main injury risk here.

name: Cricut Maker 3
description: Desktop cutter for vinyl, cardstock, iron-on transfer, and thin fabric.

name: Hakko FX-888D Soldering Station
description: Temperature-controlled soldering iron for through-hole and general electronics work.
safetyNotes: Tip runs at 350C. Use the fume extractor — solder flux fumes are a respiratory irritant. Return the iron to its stand every time you set it down.

name: Bench Fume Extractor
description: Carbon-filter fan that pulls solder flux fumes away from the work area.

name: Quick 861DW Hot Air Rework Station
description: Hot air station for surface-mount work and component removal.
safetyNotes: Airflow exits at up to 500C and is invisible. Keep the nozzle pointed away from you and let it cool fully before storing.
notes: Heating element failed 2026-08; RMA in progress.

name: Rigol DS1054Z Oscilloscope
description: 4-channel 50MHz digital oscilloscope for debugging signals.

name: Bench Power Supply 30V/5A
description: Adjustable DC power supply with current limiting.

name: Fluke 117 Digital Multimeter
description: Handheld meter for voltage, current, resistance, and continuity.

name: Saleae Logic 8 Analyzer
description: USB logic analyzer for decoding I2C, SPI, and UART traffic.

name: AmScope Inspection Microscope
description: Stereo microscope on a boom arm for fine soldering and board inspection.

name: Helping Hands with PCB Vise
description: Articulated clips and a small vise for holding boards and wires while soldering.

name: Arduino Uno R3
description: Beginner-friendly 8-bit microcontroller board with a large library ecosystem.

name: ESP32 Dev Board
description: Wi-Fi and Bluetooth microcontroller board. The default choice for anything that reports data over a network.

name: Raspberry Pi 5 Kit
description: Single-board computer with power supply and SD card. Runs Linux.

name: Digital Calipers
description: 150mm digital calipers for measuring parts before modeling them.

name: SawStop Contractor Table Saw
description: Table saw with skin-sensing blade brake. The main tool for ripping stock to width.
safetyNotes: Certification required — no exceptions. Always use the blade guard and riving knife. Use a push stick within 6 inches of the blade. Never reach over a spinning blade. Eye and ear protection required.

name: DeWalt 12" Sliding Miter Saw
description: Crosscuts boards to length, including angled and compound cuts.
safetyNotes: Let the blade reach full speed before cutting and stop fully before lifting. Keep both hands outside the marked no-hands zone. Eye and ear protection required.

name: 14" Band Saw
description: Cuts curves and resaws stock. Safer than a table saw for irregular shapes.
safetyNotes: Set the blade guard to just above the workpiece. Keep fingers out of the blade line — use a push block for narrow stock. Eye protection required.

name: Floor Standing Drill Press
description: Drills perpendicular, repeatable holes in wood, plastic, and metal.
safetyNotes: Clamp the workpiece — never hold it by hand. Loose sleeves, gloves, and long hair are entanglement hazards. Eye protection required.

name: Benchtop Thickness Planer
description: Brings rough lumber to a consistent thickness.
safetyNotes: Never plane stock shorter than 12 inches. Stand to the side, not directly behind the infeed — kickback is the hazard. Ear protection required.

name: Random Orbital Sander
description: 5-inch hook-and-loop sander for smoothing surfaces before finishing.
safetyNotes: Wood dust is a respiratory irritant — wear a dust mask and connect the dust collection hose.

name: Handheld Wood Router
description: Cuts profiles, roundovers, dados, and rabbets.
safetyNotes: Route against the direction of bit rotation. Unplug before changing bits. Eye and ear protection required.

name: Corded Jigsaw
description: Handheld saw for curves and interior cutouts in sheet goods.
safetyNotes: Keep the shoe flat on the workpiece and let the blade stop before lifting. Eye protection required.

name: Cordless Drill / Driver
description: 18V drill with a bit set and two batteries on the charger.

name: Bar Clamps (assorted sizes)
description: Clamps from 6 inches to 48 inches, on the rack by the bench.

name: Hand Tool Set (hammers, screwdrivers, pliers, wrenches)
description: General-purpose hand tools on the shadow board.
notes: Everything has an outline on the board. Please put tools back where the shape matches.

name: Utility Knives and Cutting Mats
description: Retractable blade knives with self-healing cutting mats.
safetyNotes: Cut away from your body and retract the blade before setting the knife down. Replace dull blades — a dull blade slips.

name: Heat Gun
description: Variable-temperature heat gun for shrink tubing, bending acrylic, and stripping finish.
safetyNotes: Output reaches 600C and the nozzle stays hot for several minutes after shutoff. Never point at skin. Set it down only on the metal stand.

name: Hot Glue Gun
description: Standard-size glue gun for quick mockups and fabric or cardboard joins.
safetyNotes: Molten glue causes burns that stick to skin. If you get it on you, run it under cold water rather than pulling it off.

name: Brother Label Printer
description: Label maker for bins, cables, and project parts.

name: Brother Sewing Machine
description: Computerized sewing machine with a walking foot for heavier fabrics.
safetyNotes: Keep fingers clear of the needle path and use the hand wheel for slow, tight work.

name: 15" Heat Press
description: Applies heat-transfer vinyl and sublimation prints to fabric.
safetyNotes: Platen runs at up to 200C and stays hot after power-off. Open the press with the handle only, never by hand at the edge.

name: Canon EOS R Camera Kit
description: Mirrorless camera with 24-105mm lens, two batteries, and a charger.

name: Manfrotto Tripod
description: Full-size tripod with a fluid video head.

name: Rode Wireless GO II Mic Kit
description: Two-channel wireless lavalier system for interviews and demos.

name: LED Panel Light Kit
description: Two bi-color LED panels with stands and diffusers.

name: Safety Glasses
description: ANSI Z87.1 safety glasses in the bin by the shop entrance. Over-the-glasses styles included.
safetyNotes: Required in the Wood Shop and Digital Fabrication Bay at all times, including for observers.

name: Ear Defenders
description: Over-ear hearing protection, 27dB NRR.
safetyNotes: Required when the table saw, planer, router, or CNC is running.

name: Half-Face Respirator
description: Reusable respirator with organic vapor cartridges, for resin and solvent work.
safetyNotes: A respirator only protects if it seals. Facial hair breaks the seal. Check cartridge dates before use — expired cartridges do nothing.

name: First Aid Kit
description: Wall-mounted first aid kit by the Main Shop entrance.
safetyNotes: For anything beyond a minor cut, stop work and call building security. Report every injury to Garage staff, however small.

name: MakerBot Replicator 2
description: Legacy FDM printer, retired from service.
notes: Retired 2026-03. Kept for parts only — extruder assembly is still good. Do not return to service.

name: PLA Filament (1.75mm)
description: General-purpose printing filament in black, white, grey, red, and blue.

name: PETG Filament (1.75mm)
description: Tougher, more heat-resistant filament. Better than PLA for parts that live outdoors or under load.

name: TPU Flexible Filament
description: Rubber-like flexible filament for gaskets, grips, and bumpers.

name: Standard Grey Resin (1L)
description: Formlabs standard resin for high-detail SLA prints.
safetyNotes: Skin and eye irritant. Nitrile gloves and safety glasses required when handling. Never dispose of liquid resin in a drain or regular trash — see staff for the waste container.

name: Isopropyl Alcohol 99%
description: Used to wash uncured resin prints and to clean surfaces before bonding.
safetyNotes: Highly flammable. Keep away from the laser cutter, heat guns, and soldering irons. Use with ventilation.

name: Lead-Free Solder Wire
description: 0.8mm rosin-core lead-free solder on 250g spools.
safetyNotes: Flux fumes are a respiratory irritant — use the fume extractor. Wash hands after handling.

name: Desoldering Braid
description: Copper wick for removing solder from pads and joints.

name: Jumper Wires (M-M, M-F, F-F)
description: Dupont jumper wires in assorted lengths.

name: Solderless Breadboards
description: Half-size and full-size breadboards for circuit prototyping.

name: Sensor Assortment (temperature, humidity, pressure, light)
description: Breakout boards including DHT22, BME280, and photoresistors.

name: Resistor and Capacitor Assortment
description: Through-hole resistors and capacitors in a labeled organizer.

name: Heat Shrink Tubing
description: Assorted diameters and colors for insulating splices.

name: Electrical Tape
description: Vinyl electrical tape in black and assorted colors.

name: Baltic Birch Plywood (1/4" and 1/2")
description: Laser-safe plywood sheets and offcuts. Full sheets are staff-cut on request.

name: Pine Boards (assorted)
description: Dimensional pine in 1x4 through 2x6, mostly offcuts under 4 feet.

name: Cedar Boards
description: Rot-resistant cedar, the right choice for anything that lives outside.

name: Acrylic Sheet (3mm, clear and colored)
description: Cast acrylic sheets sized for the laser bed.
safetyNotes: Cast acrylic only. Never laser-cut PVC or unmarked clear plastic — if the sheet isn't labeled, ask staff before cutting.

name: Corrugated Cardboard Sheets
description: Flat cardboard for fast, cheap mockups before committing to real material.

name: Wood Glue (Titebond III)
description: Waterproof PVA glue, suitable for outdoor projects.

name: Sandpaper (80 to 320 grit)
description: Hook-and-loop discs for the orbital sander plus sheets for hand sanding.

name: Danish Oil Finish
description: Wipe-on penetrating oil finish for bare wood.
safetyNotes: Oil-soaked rags can self-ignite. Lay them flat to dry outdoors or seal them in the metal can in the Finishing Cabinet — never ball them up in the trash.

name: Wood Screws (assorted)
description: #6 through #10 in lengths from 1/2 inch to 3 inches, plus exterior-rated screws.

name: M3 Screws, Nuts, and Standoffs
description: Metric hardware kit, the standard fastener for 3D printed and electronics enclosures.

name: Zip Ties
description: Assorted lengths, black and natural.

name: Hot Glue Sticks
description: Standard-diameter glue sticks for the glue guns on this cart.

name: Cyanoacrylate Glue and Accelerator
description: Thin and medium CA glue with spray accelerator.
safetyNotes: Bonds skin instantly. Wear gloves and keep the debonder in the same drawer within reach.

name: Nitrile Gloves
description: Disposable gloves in S through XL.
safetyNotes: Nitrile only for resin and solvents — latex does not protect against them.

name: Disposable Dust Masks (N95)
description: N95 masks for sanding and general dust exposure.
safetyNotes: A dust mask stops particulates only. It does not protect against resin, solvent, or finish vapors — use the half-face respirator for those.

name: Heat Transfer Vinyl
description: Iron-on vinyl in assorted colors, sized for the Cricut.

name: Adhesive Vinyl
description: Permanent and removable adhesive vinyl rolls.

name: Thread Assortment
description: Polyester thread in common colors, plus heavy-duty thread for canvas.

name: Felt and Canvas Remnants
description: Fabric offcuts suitable for prototyping soft goods.
